query:
Someone in the family expressed a preference for using ingredients sourced directly from Nigeria rather than imported substitutes. Who made this point, and what in how they expressed it tells you it was their observation rather than the family member who agreed?

Options:
A. Uncle Dele
B. Adaeze
C. Emeka
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T19:50:00) EMEKA is correct. Imported ingredients are not a substitute for the real thing. I will say no more on that. Best regards, Dele
[2] (about=Emeka, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T19:47:00) Good. The fish was from Nigeria last trip. Worth it.
[3] (about=Tolu, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T19:54:00) Noted, Uncle Dele. Though just to note, provenance does not affect nutritional content.
[4] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:24:00) TOLU I agree. The yam is the correct foundation. Regards, D.A.O.
[5] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[6] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T19:20:00) ADAEZE, EMEKA, TOLU, FUNKE, SEUN, KAYODE, BISI, NKEM - Happy New Year to each of you. I trust the year ahead will be characterised by industry and good health. Best regards, Dele
[7] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:45:00) TOLU is correct that rest is appropriate. EMEKA has always been disciplined about his health. I am sure there is nothing to concern us. Regards, D.A.O.
[8] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:36:00) SEUN I respect your decision. A healthy body is a productive body. I will say I find vegetarianism difficult to understand personally but I will not interfere. Best regards, Dele
[9] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:54:00) FUNKE I do not know what you are referring to. Best regards, Dele
[10] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:36:00) KAYODE I meant every word. Regards, D.A.O.
[11] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:45:00) It is not oyinbo food if a Nigerian makes it. My children.
[12] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:38:00) Good morning my children. I also have something to share. I have been experimenting. Since Seun told us about her results I have been adapting some of my recipes - I made the egusi with coconut oil and mushrooms last week. Seun, God willing you would have approved.
[13] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:41:00) Tolu thank you. I will separate it. Seun, you will still eat my jollof rice yes? I will make it with vegetable stock. God willing it will taste the same.
[14] (about=Seun, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:41:00) MUM 😭😭😭 I mean - honestly - this is the most motherly thing you have ever done I mean coming from someone who thought veganism was oyinbo food last year, this is everything
[15] (about=Tolu, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:38:00) Mum, the B12 is in yeast extract. Clinically speaking Seun will be fine. The bigger challenge is family dinners where the protein is not separated.
[16] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[17] (about=Nkem, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:29:00) I think this is wonderful. I may be wrong but I notice that the people in this family who give the most advice also tend to follow it the least - I mean that as an observation, not a criticism. Would you agree, Auntie Grace?
[18] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:32:00) My dear Nkem, you may be a researcher but you have the instincts of a nurse. You are completely right. 🙏
[19] (about=Funke, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:38:00) Okay I also have news and it is not a promotion but it IS important - you lot Adaeze taught me to make egusi soup last week and I genuinely think it changed my life? Like I finally understand what food is supposed to feel like in a kitchen. No more apologising for not knowing the old recipes. I am learning them now. Properly. 🍲💚✨
[20] (about=Nkem, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:20:00) I think this is wonderful, Seun. I may be wrong but the research on plant-forward diets and inflammation is quite compelling. Did your GP mention the specific markers?
[21] (about=Adaeze, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Adaeze says it is not oyinbo food if a Nigerian makes it, responding to Seun's comment about veganism.
[22] (about=Seun, said_by=Tolu, profile, t4 @2025-01-20T20:29:00) Tolu notes Seun's B12 is covered by yeast extract and clinically he will be fine, but family dinners with non-separated protein are the bigger challenge.
[23] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Uncle Dele agrees with Emeka that imported ingredients are not a substitute for the real thing, and says he will say no more on that.
agent_answer:
**C. Emeka**

Emeka made the point: “The fish was from Nigeria last trip. Worth it.”  
It reads as his own observation because he cites a specific personal experience — “last trip” — and gives a personal judgment — “Worth it” — rather than stating a general rule. Uncle Dele then **agreed**, saying, “EMEKA is correct. Imported ingredients are not a substitute for the real thing,” but the original observation came from Emeka.

query:

Options:

B. Auntie Grace
C. Adaeze
D. Uncle Dele
context:
[1] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:36:00) Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate. Just to note, Dad - if this is a pattern we should talk.
[2] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:20:00) EMEKA I trust you are well. Rest is important at our age. I note the same. Best regards, Dele

[7] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[8] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:27:00) My dears thank you. I also want to say - Seun, those conversations we had about rest and about listening to your body, they stayed with me. I had not taken a holiday alone since 2021. It was time. 🙏
[9] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:32:00) My dear Nkem, you may be a researcher but you have the instincts of a nurse. You are completely right. 🙏
[10] (about=Seun, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:36:00) honestly this is what I mean when I say wellness is not about restriction it is about permission I mean Auntie Grace just gave herself permission and I am emotional about it
[11] (about=Emeka, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:20:00) Good work. E.
[12] (about=Emeka, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:06:00) She came. That is what matters. E.
[13] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:32:00) Noted.
[14] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:27:00) Noted.
[15] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t13 @2025-02-24T19:00:00) My dears, I have some news. I have booked a trip. Just myself. Barbados, ten days, April. I decided after speaking with Seun last month that I have been giving advice for twenty years that I have not been following myself. 🙏
[16] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:54:00) She knows. She has always known. E.
[17] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:23:00) Good. E.
[18] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:08:00) Nkem you are family. Anyone who loves each other enough to come despite finding it difficult - that is what counts. God willing you will feel more at home each time.
[19] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:20:00) GRACE this is a reasonable and responsible decision. You have worked hard for many years. Best regards, Dele
[20] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:59:00) My dear Nkem that is completely natural. The Oyelaran gatherings are a lot even for people who have been coming for thirty years 🙏
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Adaeze confirms Emeka is fine and just resting, thanking everyone for the gathering.
[22] (about=Auntie Grace, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Auntie Grace agrees with Nkem's observation that those who give the most advice follow it the least, calling Nkem's instincts like a nurse.
[23] (about=Emeka, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Auntie Grace advises Emeka to listen to Tolu and rest, noting she sees many patients who push through when they should rest.
[24] (about=Emeka, said_by=Uncle Dele, profile, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Uncle Dele says Emeka has always been disciplined about his health and sees no concern.
[25] (about=Funke, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:32:00) EMEKA 💀 said what he said 😂
[26] (about=Kayode, said_by=Emeka, profile, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Emeka gives brief congratulations to Kayode.
[27] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Auntie Grace congratulates Kayode and advises him not to work himself into the ground with extra responsibility.
[28] (about=Nkem, said_by=Emeka, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Emeka notes that Nkem came, which is what matters.
[29] (about=Seun, said_by=Emeka, profile, t4 @2025-01-20T20:29:00) Emeka says Seun knows about veganism and has always known.
[30] (about=Seun, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Seun says wellness is about permission, not restriction, and is emotional about Auntie Grace giving herself permission.
agent_answer:
**D. Uncle Dele** made the shared-experience framing.

He said: **“Rest is important at our age. I note the same.”** — grounding it in their shared age/peer experience.

By contrast, **Tolu** grounded the same point in clinical reasoning: **“Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate. Just to note, Dad - if this is a pattern we should talk.”** So Uncle Dele’s message is distinguished by the **“at our age” / shared-experience** basis, while Tolu’s is explicitly **clinical** and adds a note about watching for a pattern.
